paragraph_audit.reason: Section 1 characterizes the license as requiring attribution for Paid Third-Party Service Use. The cited clauses, read with the full Section 6–7 text and the Attribution Notice and Paid Third-Party Service Use definitions, capture the notice content, timing, engagement frequency, subcontracting channel, accessibility, and placement limitations.

Section 4 grants the listed activities subject to the License and expressly subjects Paid Third-Party Service Use to Sections 6 and 7. The grant clauses model the activities; the cited paid-service clauses capture the applicable attribution conditions and duties, including their timing and delivery requirements.
